nodes.label: Smoke test endpoint/CORS fix and CI teardown removal
nodes.rationale: smoke-test.sh probed a nonexistent /api/memo route (should be /api/memo/weekly) causing a false FAIL, and CORS checks failed because the Origin header did not match Docker Compose's localhost:3000; fixed by probing the correct route and adding SMOKE_ORIGIN (default localhost:3000). CI docker compose tear-down was dropped from the smoke-test job on the assumption teardown works.
